jobs.title: Store Manager (FTC) - 36 Hours
jobs.desc:
Your role in the JoJo story…
Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail , we have the perfect role for you!
Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our store managers own their store, managing them as an individual business centre. As such you will take great pride in your store, your team, and your customers.
Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. You will be the driving force of the store ensuring sales targets are met, customer service is outstanding, and your team is trained and motivated to continuously amaze our customers. Pride in your store will mean you never stop pursuing perfection.
This position is offered as a Fixed‑Term Contract until 25/09/2027.
A peek into your daily adventures:
Making sure your team is equipped to uphold our B Corp principles and USP.
Own the overall performance of your store within an Omni-Channel setting. This includes managing all Ship from Store orders and Click and Collect orders to satisfy our customer needs.
Take ownership of celebrating the successes of the store performance with your team and manage any shortfall in reaching forecast by breaking down the requirement into easy to achieve targets.
Stock accuracy is of great importance to fulfil instore and Omni orders therefore you will be skilled at stock control and stock integrity principles.
No job will be too small for you and you’ll create a fun, lively and safe environment for our customers and your team. You will lead by example by including yourself in all operational tasks.
You will find training and team development enjoyable and will use all training resources to the fullest potential. This includes embracing virtual and digital training for yourself and your team members.
Outward ambassador of our B Corp principles, driving the culture through all business practices and team management.
Organise rotas and holiday allocation in a fair way.
Delegate responsibilities fairly which will stimulate and offer development throughout the team.
A typical week would be 4 x 7.5 & 1 x 6 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.
Skills that make you shine:
Previous experience as a Store Manager within a retail environment.
Previous customer service and sales experience
Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.
We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.
The ability to train and develop your team is an essential quality for this position.
You’ll be analysing the store’s performance, so a strong analytical ability is a must have.
You’ll be a great communicator with the ability to manage the concerns of the team.
We like to keep our stores looking tip top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail.
Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. To find out more about the school leaver age for Republic of Ireland- Please click the following link:
Rights of young workers (citizensinformation.ie)
Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:
Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.
Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.
Foster collaboration and open, active listening
Take ownership of all aspects of the role.
Proactively finding solutions to problems.
Leading a team.
Perks and Benefits:
Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 10 additional days.
Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!
Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.
Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.
Flexible work options.
Enjoy fabulous social events.
Saying thank you – employee recognition programme.
Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.
Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.
We love our products! Enjoy:
40% off JoJo branded lines
25% off full-price NEXT products
10% off NEXT Beauty products
Up to 10% off most branded products
Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.
Want to know more about JoJo?
We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care, always with children at the forefront of our minds.
As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce; we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.
We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

Conducts HR investigations for a high-volume portfolio of cases across multiple countries and divisions. Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

Bold
in how we dream and innovate

to feedback, challenges and opportunities

This is a customer-facing role and as a core function, you will be required to respond to customer tickets and assist customers via phone, email, and chat and resolve technical support issues in this product area. This may include Software or application issues related to the product or the Operating System (OS) that the customer is using, diagnosing issues, Installation/Upgrades, and other related issues. You will be required to collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Escalation teams to ensure customer success. A top-class Technical Support Engineer who provides valuable assistance and support while maintaining strong customer relations.

Responding to technical support tickets and providing remote support to customers
Working with customers to diagnose and resolve issues within specific response guidelines.
Manage product escalations, function as a liaison between customers, and various levels of tiered support.
Installing/Upgrading software related to this product area.
Diagnosing and troubleshooting the ticket issues that can be related to software, networking, and hardware.

Act as Subject Matter Expert in required technology area
Document technical inquiries. Develop and review content for knowledge sharing for both internal purposes and customer facing platforms.
Ability to think “out-of-the-box” and develop creative solutions to address clients’ requirements
Qualification
3+ years of experience in Technical Support, Product Support, Customer Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
Strong ability to read and analyze XML and JSON data, interpret API requests and responses, and troubleshoot issues involving REST APIs.
Experience analyzing applications, browser developer tools, endpoint telemetry, system logs, and regular expressions (regex) to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
Strong hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS environments is required.
Experience deploying and managing macOS devices using MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune or Jamf Pro.
Solid understanding of operating systems, web services, and networking fundamentals.
Knowledge of hardware platforms and networking technologies.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex software, hardware, and system integration issues.
Strong technical diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft Windows environments is highly desirable.
Experience with Linux system administration, including system and network configuration, software installation, troubleshooting, and scripting (Bash, PowerShell, or Python), is highly desirable.
Experience with one or more technologies in each of the following categories
Operating Systems Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016/2019/2022, Linux, macOS
Web Technologies IIS, Node.js, JSON, REST APIs, and web services
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Collaborative team player with customer centric mindset
Quick learner with strong analytical skills
Ability to prioritise multiple customer issues in a fast-paced environment
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Lead focused R&D projects in the context of the European SESAR research framework for future ATM technologies, including acting as overall project coordinator alongside consortium partners, being the key point of contact for the SESAR customer and internal Collins stakeholders, and overall project representative at industry dissemination events.
Shape and execute R&D activities within an international research community, including technology development within collaborative multi-national research programs.
Provide competitive advantage for Collins Aerospace business units as part of a multidisciplinary and international team of experts through contributions towards technical strategy and business development.
About you :
Typically a PhD with relevant academic or industrial experience, or a Master’s degree with strong relevant experience.
Demonstrated expertise in ATM or related operational concepts and technology domains, ideally through contributions to the SESAR research framework or similar initiatives.

Motivated self-starter with a strong enthusiasm to learn and passion for speed and agility.
Well-organized with excellent interpersonal, leadership and communication skills for effective collaboration across a global team, willing to champion and challenge new technical ideas and adapt to new challenges beyond original field of expertise.

jobs.title: Global Automation Lead
jobs.desc:
Overview
The Automation Lead is responsible for leading a global engineering group and setting the automation agenda for PGCS across two critical business areas: the Capital agenda and the Sustain agenda. This role provides strategic leadership for automation design, execution, operational technology, cybersecurity, standards, and site technical support across all PGCS sites.
The role acts as the global automation authority for strategic capital projects, site issue resolution, operational technology sustainment, and future automation capability. The Automation Lead ensures that automation standards, best practices, and cybersecurity requirements are consistently applied across strategic and base projects, while enabling reliable, secure, and future-ready manufacturing operations.
Responsibilities
Global Automation Leadership
Lead a global engineering automation group supporting PGCS manufacturing operations and capital delivery.
Define, own, and execute the global automation agenda across Capital and Sustain priorities.
Provide leadership, governance, and technical direction to ensure automation solutions are robust, scalable, secure, and aligned with business needs.
Act as the senior automation point of contact for global stakeholders, site teams, engineering, IT/OT, and external partners.
Capital Agenda: Global Design and Execution
Lead the strategic automation group responsible for the design and execution of all strategic capital projects.
Ensure automation standards, best practices, and governance requirements are followed across strategic and base capital projects for all sites.
Provide technical leadership for automation scope definition, architecture, vendor selection, design reviews, commissioning, validation, and operational handover.
Partner with capital project teams to ensure automation solutions are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required technical standard.
Serve as the SME lead for new technologies and future capital initiatives, ensuring emerging automation capability is evaluated and deployed where it creates business value.
Sustain Agenda: Operational Technology and Site Support
Lead the global Operational Technology agenda for PGCS automation, supporting sustain processes, IT/OT initiatives, and technology projects.
Manage the automation technology sustain program, ensuring platforms, infrastructure, software, and standards remain current, reliable, and secure.
Provide global site technical support and issue resolution, acting as the escalation point for automation-related challenges across all sites.
Lead problem solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for complex automation and OT issues escalated by sites.
Provide SME leadership in System Platform, Digital Factory, software migration, cybersecurity, change management, and related automation technologies.
Automation Standards and Governance
Own and maintain the PGCS automation standards portfolio, including 25 automation standards that define best practice across automation initiatives and projects.
Ensure standards are consistently applied across capital projects, sustain activities, site initiatives, vendor deliverables, and technology deployments.
Drive continuous improvement of standards based on lessons learned, technology evolution, cybersecurity requirements, and operational feedback.
Provide governance and assurance to ensure automation designs are consistent, supportable, secure, and aligned to PGCS and PepsiCo requirements.
Cybersecurity and IT/OT Compliance
Ensure PGCS compliance with cybersecurity sustain standards including NIST, ISA/IEC 62443, and PepsiCo Global Controls across all sites.
Lead the mitigation of cybersecurity risks across operational technology environments, working with sites, IT, engineering, and external partners.
Ensure all sites are progressing completion and build-out of DAS networks in line with cybersecurity and operational requirements.
Support cybersecurity assessments, remediation plans, system hardening, change management, backup and recovery, and audit readiness across the automation landscape.
Qualifications
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Engineering, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
Significant experience in automation, controls, operational technology, or digital manufacturing within a complex manufacturing environment.
Proven experience leading global or multi-site automation teams, programs, standards, and governance models.
Strong track record in capital project automation design, execution, commissioning, and operational handover.
Demonstrated knowledge of OT cybersecurity, IT/OT integration, industrial networks, and automation system lifecycle management.
Technical Expertise
Automation architecture, PLC, HMI, SCADA, System Platform, historian, and industrial network technologies.
Digital Factory, smart manufacturing, data connectivity, and future automation technologies.
OT cybersecurity frameworks including NIST, ISA/IEC 62443, and corporate global controls.
Software migration, platform lifecycle management, technology sustainment, and change control.
Capital project delivery, vendor management, commissioning, validation, and operational readiness
Leadership Competencies
Strategic leadership and ability to set a compelling automation vision.
Strong stakeholder management across global engineering, operations, IT, cybersecurity, and site leadership teams.
Ability to influence standards adoption and drive governance across multiple sites and projects.
Excellent problem-solving capability with the ability to lead complex technical issue resolution.
Strong coaching, communication, and capability-building skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.desc:
Description
This role can be performed from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain. There will be travel required up to 30% of the time, mostly within the EU.
About The Role
Join Amazon's Employee Experience & Relations (EXR) team in Europe and play a decisive role in shaping how 12 countries navigate one of the most complex labor relations environments in the world.
As the EU EXR Business Partner (BP) for OPS Central Functions & RME Tech field, you will develop and own end-to-end employee and labor relations strategies for the business populations you cover across the EU. You will serve as a direct strategic advisor to the most senior EU Operations leaders - including the VPs who run mission-critical functions - counselling them on employee experience, regulatory compliance and labor relations risk so they can make informed, confident decisions with significant business impact.
Reporting into the EU Business Partners and Project, Compliance & Risk ER Director, you will cover OPS Central Functions & RME Tech field across Europe — primarily IT Ops & RME, 3P Transportation & Scaling, and Supply Chain Transformation Planning & Ops Excellence. Each function reports to distinct VPs and presents unique employee experience dynamics - from highly specialized technical teams with outsized operational leverage to scaling organizations navigating rapid transformation, along with field team living day-to-day at the pace of the miles - requiring a Business Partner who can diagnose distinct needs, develop proportionate strategies, and deliver pragmatic counsel while maintaining strategic coherence and Amazon's EXR standards.
As the EXR Business Partner for those VPs, you will act as a trusted advisor who translates business priorities and challenges to EXR plans and outcomes. You will look closely after the employee experience in scope, and partner with PXT to build convincing improvement strategies. You will support organizational changes and respond to emerging business and risk opportunities at EU level. You will work in close collaboration with other EXR Business Partners, Country Field ER teams, and respective Head of Country ER Leadership to deliver specific country insights and ensure that fair, consistent, and transparent employee experience processes are applied across all operations.
Key job responsibilities
Role
As an EXR Business Partner, you will be the trusted strategic advisor who translates complex business priorities into actionable employee and labor relations strategies. This role is a strategic advisory and relationship-driven role where your primary impact comes from:
The quality of counsel you provide to senior leaders navigating ambiguous, high-stakes situations
Your ability to connect regulatory, operational, and human dynamics into coherent strategies
The trust you build as the go-to partner whom VPs seek out before making workforce decisions
Your judgment in balancing business agility with employee experience and compliance imperatives
Specifically, You Will
Develop end-to-end ELR strategies for the business populations you serve, ensuring each strategy is grounded in local regulatory context, business operating models, and workforce dynamics across the EU;
Advise VPs and senior leaders directly on labor relations risk exposure, regulatory compliance obligations, and employee experience opportunities - providing clear, data-backed recommendations that enable timely decision-making;
Identify, assess, and mitigate pan-EU employee relations risk by leveraging risk frameworks, employee listening mechanisms, site assessments, and workforce analytics to surface trends before they escalate;
Shape the employee experience across your customer groups by designing targeted interventions, visiting site to get employee’s experience feedback firsthand, testing solutions through local ER partnerships, and scaling what works across the network;
Navigate regulatory complexity by maintaining deep awareness of evolving EU labor legislation and advising business leaders on compliance implications about strategic projects, mitigation options, and strategic positioning;
Lead through influence during critical moments - including organizational change, workforce restructuring, and crisis situations - partnering with ER Country Leaders to ensure coordinated, legally sound, and employee-centric responses;
Drive strategic coherence across diverse populations by developing tailored approaches for each business function while maintaining a unified pan-EU framework that delivers consistency, fairness, and transparency;
Partner cross-functionally with PxT, Legal, L&D, GOLD, and Operations Corporate teams to build leader capability and deliver cohesive employee experience across all touchpoints.
A day in the life
Operational Excellence
Use operational data, EXR metrics, and business KPIs to develop persuasive narratives and evidence-based recommendations
Lead and deliver complex, cross-functional strategy at pan-EU scale from scoping through execution and measurement of impact
Deliver innovative solutions that challenge the status quo and drive measurable improvements in employee experience
Define and track success metrics for EXR initiatives, ensuring accountability and continuous improvement
Leadership Capabilities
Navigate high ambiguity and competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction, exercising sound judgment to drive outcomes
Influence senior leaders through data-driven insights, pragmatic solutions, and deep understanding of their respective business challenges
Build and sustain constructive, trusted advisory relationships with senior leaders and multiple stakeholders across functions and geographies
Produce high-quality written communications that analyse problems, present data-backed options, and recommend clear paths forward
Self Development
Seek learning opportunities and champion new ideas within the EXR function
Reflect on strengths and growth areas, actively seeking feedback from peers and stakeholders
Lead authentically through self-awareness and transparency
Build a diverse network of leaders across the organization
Develop strong working relationships with VPs, along with internal and external partners
About The Team
The EU Employee Experience & Relations team is a high-performing, pan-European function supporting all Amazon Operations business lines to drive employee experience and manage labor relations strategies across the EU Region. Acting as a Center of Expertise, we are committed to building capability, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering positive employee relations & constructive labor relations at scale. Our team operates at the intersection of strategy and execution - partnering closely with Operations, Legal, Public Relations, and Global EXR to advise on critical initiatives and deliver solutions that matter for our employees and customers.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree
Experience in Employee Experience / Labor Relations roles, with demonstrated multi-country EU exposure
Fluency in written and spoken English (Common European Framework of Reference C2)
Proven track record of building trusted advisory relationships with executive stakeholders (Director level and above)
Experience leading organizational change initiatives across multiple countries in a complex, matrixed organization
Demonstrated ability to use data and business metrics to inform EXR strategy and recommendations
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant postgraduate education in human resources or employee/labor relations
Fluency in an additional European language (Common European Framework of Reference C2)
Experience supporting corporate/central functions or specialized technical populations (as distinct from high-volume frontline operations)
Proven ability to design, pilot, and scale employee experience programs from concept to measurable impact
Strong project management skills with experience le

Part-Time, Permanent | 32 Hours per Week
Salary up to €42,000 per annum (equivalent to €52,500 FTE)
Start Date: October 2026 (flexible)
Join a Practice Where Relationships Matter
At Sunbeam Vets Kinsale Road, we believe great veterinary care starts with great relationships. We're looking for a Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and dedicated team in a well-established first opinion practice that has become a trusted part of the local community.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a confident GP vet who enjoys building lasting client relationships, delivering excellent clinical care, and working as part of a close-knit, supportive team. Our clients are loyal, engaged, and genuinely value the continuity and personal approach that our practice provides.
You'll be joining a small, experienced team where every individual makes a real difference, with the backing and resources of the wider Sunbeam Veterinary Group when needed.
The Opportunity
This role offers an excellent balance of medicine, surgery, preventative healthcare, and client engagement. As a key member of the clinical team, you'll manage a varied caseload of first opinion small animal cases, providing high-quality care from initial consultation through to diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing case management.
You'll be comfortable independently working up medical cases, developing treatment plans, interpreting diagnostic results, and performing routine soft tissue surgeries. While more advanced and specialist procedures can be referred to our larger teams and referral services within the Sunbeam network, we are looking for a vet who is confident managing day-to-day GP veterinary work without close supervision.
The role also includes elements of sole charge, making it ideally suited to an experienced veterinary surgeon who enjoys autonomy while still benefiting from the support of a collaborative team environment.
An interest in exotic species would be welcomed but is not essential.
Who We're Looking For
We're seeking a well-rounded Small Animal GP Veterinary Surgeon who is passionate about delivering excellent patient care and building strong relationships with clients and colleagues alike.
To be successful in this role, you must be VCI registered and confident managing routine first opinion medical and surgical cases independently. This includes procedures such as dog and cat spays, lump removals, routine diagnostics, case workups, and ongoing medical management.
Due to the level of autonomy required, this position is not suitable for new graduates or veterinary surgeons who require close supervision, structured mentorship, or extensive clinical support. We are looking for someone who can confidently contribute from day one and thrive within a busy first opinion environment.
A Supportive Team with a Community Focus
Sunbeam Vets Kinsale Road is home to a small and experienced team consisting of two veterinary surgeons, two veterinary nurses, and a dedicated receptionist. Together, we've built a welcoming practice where teamwork, trust, and client care are at the heart of everything we do.
Many of our clients have been with us for years, creating a genuine community atmosphere and allowing our team to develop meaningful, long-term relationships with both pets and their owners.
As part of the wider Sunbeam Veterinary Group, you'll also have access to the expertise, facilities, and support of a larger network including clinics in Blackpool, Cobh, and Passage West, as well as our specialist referral and emergency services.
Modern Facilities with the Support of a Larger Network
Our Kinsale Road branch is well-equipped with digital radiography, dental radiography, ultrasound, and in-house diagnostic capabilities, enabling efficient and thorough patient care.
Across The Wider Sunbeam Group, We Offer
24/7 emergency and critical care with round-the-clock veterinary cover
A team of approximately 9 veterinary surgeons and 15 qualified veterinary nurses
In-house laboratory services
Soft tissue and orthopaedic surgery
Advanced diagnostic imaging
Dental services
Canine hydrotherapy and rehabilitation
Dedicated nurse-led clinics including weight management, dental care, puppy, and senior pet clinics
Life in Kinsale Road, Cork
Located on the south side of Cork City, Kinsale Road offers the perfect balance of city convenience and community charm. With excellent transport links, easy access to Cork city centre, Cork Airport, and some of Ireland's most beautiful coastal towns, it's a fantastic place to live and work.
The area combines the energy of a thriving city with the warmth of a local neighbourhood, creating an ideal environment for veterinary professionals who enjoy becoming a valued part of their local community.

This is a permanent part-time position working 32 hours per week on a planned rota basis, with schedules provided in advance.

Free Flu Vaccinations

jobs.title: Senior Full-stack Software Engineer
jobs.desc:
What You Will Do
Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking a
Senior Software Engineer
to join our AI Engineering team. This is a
hands-on, full-stack role
focused on building the front-end and back-end application layers that enable AI teams to deliver enterprise solutions.
You will work alongside AI engineers, data scientists, platform engineers, product teams to move AI use cases from proof of concept into secure, scalable and supportable products. You will build user interfaces in Blazor and React, develop APIs and services in .NET and Python, and integrate applications with generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows and enterprise data services.
This role suits an experienced software engineer who understands that successful AI products require more than a model: they require strong application architecture, thoughtful user experience, robust integration, security, observability, testing and disciplined software delivery.
As this is a
Cork-based hybrid role requiring attendance in the office three days per week
, candidates who are not currently based in Cork or the surrounding area would be expected to relocate.
How You Will Do It
Full-stack application engineering
Design, build and maintain production-grade web applications that expose AI capabilities through clear, responsive and accessible user experiences.
Develop component-based front ends using C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript, applying responsive design, accessibility and reusable design-system patterns.
Build secure back-end services and REST APIs using C# and .NET, with Python services where required for AI and data integration.
Design application boundaries, contracts and integration patterns across front ends, APIs, AI services, data stores and enterprise platforms.
Implement authentication, authorisation, input validation, error handling, auditability and secure management of secrets and configuration.
Improve performance, reliability and maintainability through profiling, caching, asynchronous processing and sound engineering patterns.
AI application development
Integrate applications with Azure OpenAI and other approved model endpoints, Azure AI Foundry capabilities, AI Search, vector stores and enterprise APIs.
Build application experiences for conversational AI, enterprise search, document intelligence, summarisation, recommendations and AI-assisted workflows.
Implement streaming responses, citations and source attribution, structured outputs, tool calling, conversation state and human-in-the-loop controls.
Collaborate with AI engineers on RAG and agentic solutions, translating model or workflow capabilities into well-designed user-facing features.
Implement practical safeguards including prompt and output validation, content filtering, access controls, graceful fallback and clear user feedback.
Measure and optimise end-to-end quality, latency, reliability and cost, including the application behaviour around non-deterministic AI responses.
Software delivery and operational excellence
Own features through design, implementation, code review, automated testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
Create unit, component, integration, contract and end-to-end tests using TypeScript, PowerShell and C# where appropriate, including test strategies for AI-enabled and streaming user journeys.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, applying quality gates, environment configuration and repeatable release practices.
Containerise applications and deploy to Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps or AKS, as appropriate.
Instrument applications with logs, metrics, traces and usage telemetry; diagnose production issues and participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to secure coding, accessibility, privacy, Responsible AI, architecture and engineering standards across the AI application portfolio.
Technical leadership and collaboration
Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to turn ambiguous business needs into measurable, testable software requirements and incremental delivery plans.
Provide technical direction through solution design, architecture discussions, code reviews and pragmatic trade-off decisions.
Mentor engineers in full-stack design, software quality, AI integration and production engineering practices.
Create reusable components, reference implementations and development patterns that help multiple AI teams deliver consistently.
Communicate technical risks, dependencies and options clearly to engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Experience
What we look for
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with evidence of senior-level ownership of production applications.
Strong hands-on experience building modern web applications with C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript on the front end, and C#/.NET back-end services.
Production experience with Razor/Blazor user interfaces, including component design, state management, CSS styling, JavaScript interoperability and front-end testing.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating front ends with distributed back-end services.
Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled applications, such as generative AI, LLM, RAG, conversational AI, document intelligence or agent-based solutions.
Experience with Azure-hosted applications and automated delivery using Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to take software from design through deployment and operational support in an enterprise environment.
Experience creating automation and test tooling with TypeScript, PowerShell and C#.
Desired Qualifications
Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or comparable orchestration frameworks.
Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, Cosmos DB, Redis, PostgreSQL/pgvector or other vector-capable data services.
Experience with real-time communication and streaming technologies such as SignalR, Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control and enterprise API security.
Experience implementing WCAG-aligned accessible interfaces and working with enterprise design systems.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AKS or API Management.
Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt/version management, tracing, cost controls, Responsible AI, privacy and AI governance.
Experience in IoT, smart buildings, industrial applications or other operational technology domains.

Key responsibilities: Brand & marketing
•Help plan Folláin's content calendar and brand campaigns, developing creative ideas and engaging content across social and digital platforms.
• Support the planning, creation and management of our social media and paid Meta campaigns, monitoring performance, analysing results and spotting ways to improve.
• Help coordinate PR drops, influencer activity and brand collaborations that grow Folláin's reach and connect us with new audiences.
• Get involved in brand activations, consumer events, trade shows and sampling that bring the Folláin brand to life.
•Work with our e-commerce and wider team on website updates, new product information, content and promotions, so campaigns are consistent across every consumer touchpoint.
Key responsibilities: Sales & account co-ordination
• Support the growth of our products within key domestic and export customer accounts.
• Liaise regularly with key accounts to keep them satisfied with our products and service, resolving any concerns and keeping communication flowing between Folláin teams and customer contacts.
• Help activate our trade plans with key customers, and work with the field sales team so store activations, promotions and sales objectives are delivered at store level.
• Help grow Folláin in foodservice, identifying opportunities to increase awareness, distribution and sales.
• Assist in preparing key account presentations, including head office sampling sessions and in-store tastings.
• Identify new product opportunities through market research and store audits, and share category insights with existing and potential customers.
• Build and share clear internal reports that support business planning and decision-making.
What You'll Gain
•Real ownership of campaigns and content that go live to our customers and followers.
•Hands-on experience across both marketing and sales in a fast-growing Irish FMCG brand.
•Exposure to retail, foodservice and export customers, including head office meetings and trade shows.
•Ongoing mentoring and regular feedback from our marketing and sales team.
We're Looking For Someone Who
•Is currently studying towards, or has recently completed, a third-level degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, Food Business or a related discipline.
• Is passionate about food, FMCG and the success of the Irish food industry, and excited to represent a proudly Irish brand known for great-tasting, wholesome, high-quality products.
• Is creative and digitally savvy, with a strong interest in content creation, social media and digital marketing.
• Knows Instagram, TikTok and Meta advertising well; familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Canva and WooCommerce is an advantage.
• Communicates clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, including with customers.
• Is well organised and can juggle several projects at once.
• Is comfortable with Excel and working with data to track performance and build reports.
How to apply
Send your CV and a short cover letter to [email address] by [closing date]. Tell us why Folláin, and share an example of content or a campaign you've created, if you have one.
Folláin is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to discuss any reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process.

Contract Type:

The Training Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and implementation of learning solutions across Kinsale, including administration of Kinsale curricula. The Training Coordinator partners with the business to ensure curricula adequately reflect job responsibilities and compliance-based activities. The Training Coordinator is responsible for training projects identified as fulfilling the learning capability and competency gaps in the assigned business area/function. Additionally, the Training Coordinator is responsible for activities required to maintain the overall state of compliance of the Training Compliance program.
The Training Coordinator monitors process, progress, results, and designs feedback loops into their work against measured goals. The Training Coordinator should anticipate and adjust for problems and roadblocks, interface with learning service suppliers, and integrate new business processes where necessary for success. The Training Coordinator provides support to ensure personnel are qualified and capable, which includes personnel fulfilling compliance requirements and continually increasing their contribution to the business.

Identify, analyze, and determine solutions regarding learning gaps.
Define requirements for personnel qualification in assigned business area/function; ensure implementation and ongoing maintenance.
Create, revise, and implement training and related documents, ensuring all documents are well written and executable.
Evaluate effectiveness of existing and planned learning interventions.
Evaluate human errors in business units and determine appropriate human error reduction interventions.

Drive quality standards through review of project documents, design, deliverables, final learning content and evaluation data.

Benchmark within Learning and Development organizations in other sites, seeking sharing and replication opportunities.

Surface improvement opportunities within Training Compliance.

Effectively communicate updates for projects and assignments.
Curriculum Architecture and Assignment
Identify target audience for specific learning intervention.
Create and maintain duty-aligned curricula with business partners and support curricula owners in the business.
Ensure accuracy and appropriateness of target audience definitions for courses owned by assigned business area/function in the Learning Management System (LMS).
Troubleshoot curriculum architecture and assignment and resolve issues.
Implement centrally-developed process improvements in local area.

Demonstrated program/project management skills
Experience with learning & development and SOP business processes

Ability to work independently and in a team environment
Responsible for maintaining a safe work environment, working safely and accountable for supporting all Corporate and Site Goals
Additional Preferences:
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
Experience in business area/function as well as knowledge of companion tools used to execute broader business processes (such as CAPA tools/TrackWise, document repositories/Veeva QualityDocs)
Experience in supplier oversight
Ability to effectively partner outside functional area
Ability to navigate complex organizations
Strong organizational skills
Demonstrated ability to coach others
Education Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree or 2+ years of experience in a Learning & Development role

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, EMEA Statutory Accounting AWS & LEO
jobs.desc:
Description
Join us in a pivotal accounting role where you'll shape financial reporting for a global technology leader. You'll work on statutory compliance and financial statements for Amazon Web Services and our satellite connectivity initiative, serving communities worldwide with innovative broadband solutions. This position offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on how we report financial performance across multiple regions while collaborating with teams around the globe.
Key job responsibilities
Prepare month-end statutory close journal entries and supporting documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards
Develop interim and year-end statutory financial statements for legal entities, applying appropriate accounting frameworks and principles
Coordinate the statutory filing process for legal entities across multiple regions, managing timelines and regulatory requirements
Support external audit activities by responding to audit requests, providing documentation, and facilitating communication between internal teams and external auditors
Analyze complex business transactions and develop technical accounting position papers to determine appropriate accounting treatment
A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on statutory reporting and compliance work that directly supports our financial integrity across the organization. You might start your day reviewing month-end close requirements, then transition into preparing statutory financial statements for our legal entities. Throughout the week, you'll coordinate with our external audit partners, develop technical accounting analyses for complex transactions, and manage submissions to regulatory bodies. You'll also engage with finance teams across different regions and business units, ensuring alignment on accounting treatments and timely completion of filings. Your work will span multiple time zones and require coordination with colleagues in various functions, giving you exposure to how global financial operations work at scale.
Finance and Global Business Services
About The Team
We support both Amazon Web Services and our satellite connectivity initiative, which is bringing high-speed internet to underserved communities worldwide. Our statutory reporting and compliance team is committed to maintaining the highest standards of financial accuracy and regulatory adherence. We work collaboratively across regions and functions, valuing diverse perspectives and shared problem-solving. Our team is focused on building robust financial reporting processes that support informed decision-making across the organization. You'll join colleagues who are passionate about technical accounting excellence and take pride in delivering reliable financial information to stakeholders globally. We're excited to welcome someone who can contribute to our mission of financial transparency while growing their expertise in a dynamic, international environment.
Amazon Affinity Groups
Basic Qualifications
CPA
Bachelor's degree in accounting, information systems, finance, or equivalent
Experience working with stakeholders
Strong audit and technical accounting experience with accounting and financial reporting, preferably gained within a Big Four firm and / or a multinational organization
Certified accountant qualification (ACA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent)
Preferred Qualifications
Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or other accounting frameworks;

Drive architecture development and innovation for new circuit designs and methodologies, contributing to IP development and patent generation
Drive innovation in mixed-signal design approaches, developing new theories and methods that advance the company's technological capabilities
Lead complex mixed-signal projects with significant business impact, directing work of engineering teams without formal management responsibility

Drive regional university engagements to build and maintain strong talent pipelines

Simulation and Modeling Mastery: Advanced proficiency with simulation modeling tools (SPICE, Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre) and ability to develop custom simulation methodologies
Integrated Circuit Layout: Deep understanding of physical IC layout considerations and experience optimizing layouts for performance, including guiding layout engineers on critical aspects
Communication and Influence: Outstanding ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, drive design reviews, and mentor junior engineers across multiple complex projects
Preferred Education And Experience
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with at least 15 years of relevant industry experience
Strong record of accomplishment and innovation (ex: leadership of commercially successful development efforts, patents, presentations at leading conferences, publications in leading journals)

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician (Weekend Cover)
jobs.desc:
Laboratory Technician (Weekend Cover) - Charleville
About The Role
We have great opportunity for a Laboratory (Sampling) Technician in our Kinisla site in Charleville, Co. Cork.
This is a part-time role, to cover Plant 1 & Plant 2 labs at weekends, including bank holidays. Working hours are 06:00 - 15:00. Overtime is available.
The successful candidate will help to ensure, that our products continue to meet the highest quality standards and delighting our customers, working within the team and reporting to a Quality Manager.
Kinisla Group's UK & Ireland dairy related business includes Dairy Ingredients, Dairy Nutritional Ingredients, Dairy Consumer Foods, and Agribusiness. With a revenue in excess of €1bn per year, it is one of the world's leading dairy businesses. With our strong dairy heritage and deep-rooted connection to our 3,000 milk suppliers, right through to our portfolio of innovative and high-quality brands, the dairy business has a unique and compelling proposition for both consumers and our customers.
Our dairy business has a diversified portfolio of dairy, nutritional ingredients and market leading dairy brands and its vertically integrated dairy processing ensures the highest quality, sustainably produced 1.2bn litres of milk for our dairy, nutritional ingredients, and consumer foods business - a key consideration among some of our largest customers across the globe.
What will I be doing?
In process product chemical testing of samples according to documented procedures paying attention to sample preparation & control to prevent cross contamination of samples and temperature controls
Maintaining accurate and clearly documented testing records to ensure traceability
Adhering to regulations & policies set down in place around GMP, hygiene, health & safety
Chemical analysis: pH, fats, salt, moisture
Raw material collection & analysis
Preparation and executing Environmental swabbing within the production area
Carrying out required temperature checks in the production area
Managing shelf life samples
Managing samples to go external lab for micro testing
Carrying out adhoc duties as required
Entering test results into SAP
What do I need to be successful?
In Kinisla we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.
These include:
Accuracy & high level of attention to detail
Able to manage workload and time efficiently
Ability to work independently & off own initiative without supervision
Effective communication skills
Ability to problem solve independently
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel
Excellent understanding of computers & ability to work independently on computers
Ability to quickly learn & understand how to use computer programmes
Must be available for weekends & occasional Mon-Fri cover
Preferably hold a full driver's licence
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 28 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,700 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.
Get in touch today!
At Kinisla, we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.
Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kinisla and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.

Additionally, we will not consider or agree to payment of any recruiter fee under these circumstances. This also applies to CVs or candidate profiles sent directly to any Kinisla Hiring Managers.

jobs.title: Payroll and HR Systems Administrator
jobs.desc:
About Sunbird
Sunbird Solar Solutions is a pan-European Solar developer and Asset Manager of commercial and industrial solar PV plants across Poland, Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, Ireland and the United Kingdom. We deliver clean, green energy to businesses and property owners, generating both environmental benefit and financial return, and in doing so we contribute to addressing the climate crisis, energy security and the rising cost of energy.
As a group we aim to provide life changing and career defining opportunities for our people.
The Role
This is a part-time, hands-on administrative role for an organised and discreet person who will keep payroll and people administration running smoothly across our European operations.
Reporting to the Group CFO and based in our Cork office, with hybrid working, you will work with our external payroll providers, keep employee records accurate and up to date, and support hiring managers with onboarding and offboarding.
Flexible Hours
The hours are part-time, with some flexiblity in timing. The workload is naturally heavier around month end and lighter during the rest of the month.
Key Responsibilities
Payroll administration
Co-ordinate monthly payroll with our external payroll providers and act as their day-to-day point of contact
Collate and check payroll input, and review output before it goes for approval
Provide joiner, change and leaver details so people are paid correctly from their first month
Issue payslips and support payroll queries from employees
Finance administration
Support the loading of monthly payments process for payroll and consultants, preparing information for approval
Keep a clear record of what has been processed, what is pending and what needs follow-up
Employee records
Maintain our HR system as the single source of truth for employee records
Check recorded holiday, absence and leave, and check balances against payroll
Handle employee personal data carefully and in line with GDPR/DPA
Onboarding and offboarding
Work with hiring managers and IT, so that contracts, systems access and payroll are aligned for joiners, movers and leavers
Prepare contracts and offer letters from approved templates for sign-off
Keep right-to-work records up to date
Handle leaver administration
Benefits And Compliance Administration
Administer employee benefits
Keep policy documents up to date as changes are approved
Keep compliance deadlines and records on track with our advisers
Meeting Support (depending On Experience)
Depending on your experience, you may also take minutes at internal meetings.
Required Qualifications
Experience in payroll and/or HR administration, ideally across more than one country
Experience working with outsourced payroll providers
A highly organised person with excellent attention to detail, and absolute discretion with confidential information
Trustworthy and comfortable handling sensitive personal and financial information
Confident with HR systems
Fluent written and spoken English
Organised and self-motivated, able to manage your own time within flexible hours
Based in, or able to commute to, Cork, Ireland.
You must already have the right to work in Ireland; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
A payroll qualification, such as those offered by the Irish Payroll Association (IPASS)
Experience of taking meeting minutes
An additional European language
Experience in renewables, infrastructure or another multi-country business
Success Metrics
Payroll delivered accurately and on time every month
Employee records complete, current and trusted
Queries handled promptly, with nothing left sitting
Joiners, movers and leavers handled smoothly with hiring managers
Good working relationships with our payroll providers and advisers
What We Offer
Part-time hours that are flexible in timing, to fit around school runs and other commitments
Hybrid working from our Cork office
Work in a high performing culture with other A team players
Exposure to a growing, multi-country business
All tools and IT equipment required to perform the role

The Inventory Specialist is a key role within the Site Supply Chain team, responsible for ensuring effective inventory governance, optimization, and financial control across onsite operations, external warehouse locations, and the wider end-to-end supply chain.

Preferred

jobs.title: Quantity Surveyor
jobs.desc:
Senior Quantity Surveyor – Structural Steel
📍
Ireland – Southern Ireland Projects
💼
Permanent | Full Time
Steel projects can move quickly.
Drawings change. Site conditions develop. Additional work appears. Subcontractors need managing and clients need paying.
The difference between a project that simply gets delivered and one that delivers commercially comes down to what happens between those moments.
That's where you come in.
As Senior Quantity Surveyor, you'll take ownership of the commercial side of structural steel projects, working closely with project, site and fabrication teams from the initial take-off through to final account.
The Role
You'll be involved across the full commercial lifecycle of your projects.
You'll review drawings, complete take-offs for structural steel, decking and cladding, identify changes from the original tender and make sure those changes are captured commercially.
You'll manage subcontractor procurement and accounts, prepare interim payment applications, negotiate variations and claims, and keep pressure on outstanding client payments.
You'll also spend time on site, seeing the work first-hand and understanding exactly what is happening before making commercial decisions.
From cost planning through to completion, you'll be responsible for making sure the numbers reflect the work being delivered.
What You'll Bring
7+ years' Quantity Surveying experience
Strong background in structural steel or similar specialist construction
Good understanding of contracts and commercial project management
Experience managing variations, claims, procurement and final accounts
Ability to read construction drawings and complete accurate take-offs
Strong negotiation and communication skills
Confident working independently while remaining closely connected to the wider project team
Good knowledge of Excel, Word, Outlook and project management systems
Degree or relevant qualification in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline
Experience within the Irish steelwork market is advantageous, but not essential
Why This Role?
This isn't a QS position where your involvement ends when the numbers go into a spreadsheet.
You'll be close to the projects, visiting sites, working with project teams, dealing directly with clients and subcontractors, and seeing the steel you're commercially responsible for being delivered.
You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of projects within a specialist structural steel environment, with plenty of scope to use your commercial experience rather than simply administer someone else's processes.
If you're an experienced Quantity Surveyor who understands that you can't properly manage the commercial side of steel without understanding what's happening on site, this could be worth a conversation.
Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.desc:
Project Manager – Structural Steel & Modular Buildings
📍 Location: Tipperary
💼 Permanent | Full Time
The steel and modular buildings leaving this business don't just sit in a factory waiting for someone else to work out what happens next.
They become industrial buildings, agricultural projects, sports facilities and volumetric structures across Ireland, the UK and Europe, and someone needs to make sure everything between the signed order and the final handover happens when it should.
That's where you come in.
As Project Manager, you'll take ownership of projects from award through to completion, bringing design, fabrication, logistics and site teams together so the right steel and modules arrive at the right place, in the right sequence, with the right paperwork behind them.
You'll be working on projects where a late drawing, missed variation or poorly planned delivery doesn't just create an awkward phone call — it can hold up a factory, a site crew and an entire programme.
Your job is to see those problems coming.
What you'll be doing
You'll have ownership of your projects rather than simply being responsible for updating a programme.
That means getting scope and drawings locked down before fabrication starts, working closely with engineers and detailers, keeping production moving and making sure site teams have what they need before the steel or modules arrive.
You'll keep a close eye on cost, programme and risk, dealing with changes before they become disputes and keeping clients informed when decisions need to be made.
You'll also work with subcontractors, suppliers and logistics teams, making sure everyone understands what is required and when.
And when the project is finished, you'll make sure it actually gets finished, variations agreed, costs reconciled, handover documentation complete and the lessons from the job passed back into the next estimate.
The projects
This isn't a role where you'll spend your time managing the same type of building over and over again.
You'll see structural steel, cladding and modular/offsite construction across industrial, agricultural, sports and volumetric projects, with work extending across Ireland, the UK and Europe.
Some projects will be won and delivered quickly. Others will have more moving parts, multiple trades and plenty of opportunity for something to go wrong.
That's what makes the role important.
You'll be the person joining the dots between what was sold, what was designed, what is being fabricated and what eventually arrives on site.
What you'll bring
You'll already understand what it takes to deliver a construction project rather than simply administer one.
Ideally, you'll have experience managing structural steel, cladding, modular or offsite projects from award through to erection and handover.
You'll be comfortable reading fabrication drawings, understanding programmes and cost reports, challenging information that doesn't look right and having conversations with clients when scope or programme changes.
Experience managing variations, subcontractors and logistics is important, as is an understanding of CE marking, quality records and project handover documentation.
Most importantly, you'll be someone who can walk into a problem early, understand what is causing it and get the right people around the table before it becomes a much bigger one.
Why this role?
You'll have genuine influence over the outcome of the projects you manage.
You're not simply maintaining a spreadsheet while someone else makes the important decisions. You'll be working between the office, factory and site, seeing how decisions made during design and planning eventually affect fabrication and erection.
You'll also be joining a specialist business with decades of experience in steel and light-gauge construction, with established fabrication and modular capabilities behind you.
If you enjoy taking something complicated, bringing the moving parts together and eventually standing back to see the finished building on site, this is a role where you'll see the result of your work.
Interested?
If you've delivered structural steel, modular or offsite projects and you're ready for a role where you can genuinely own the outcome, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation about the project, the business and what the role could look like.

jobs.title: Project Development (Internship)
jobs.desc:
Statkraft is a leading company in hydropower internationally and Europe's largest generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, and gas-fired power. Statkraft is a global company in energy market operations and has around 6,200 employees in 20 countries.
Because in the fight against climate change, we do not see renewable energy as part of the solution – we believe it must be the solution.
We are seeking a Project Development Intern on a six month internship to support the business area's Project Development team. The team is responsible for the development and execution of large-scale renewable energy projects, including wind and solar developments, from early-stage identification through to investment decision.
Job Description
As a Project Development Intern, you will gain hands-on experience working alongside Project Managers and technical specialists, supporting the development of renewable energy projects while building knowledge of the renewable energy sector.
Support the development of wind and solar renewable energy projects through activities such as site screening, land and grid assessments, environmental studies, and project coordination.
Assist with environmental assessment processes for renewable energy developments.
Provide administrative and project support to Project Managers, including preparing project reports, maintaining project documentation, and tracking actions.
Support early-stage project development activities, including landowner engagement, community consultation preparation, grid research, and wind monitoring activities.
Assist in coordinating third-party consultants and reviewing consultant deliverables.
Support the technical design team through data gathering, document management, and project coordination.
Participate in project meetings and contribute to discussions on project risks, opportunities, and progress.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of high environmental, health, safety, and sustainability standards.
Assist with general research and analysis relating to renewable energy markets, planning processes, and development opportunities.
Qualifications
Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Renewable Energy, Geography, Planning, Natural Sciences, or a related discipline.
Strong interest in renewable energy and the development of wind and solar projects.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint.
Interest in planning, consenting, environmental assessments, or project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Well organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Proactive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced project environment.
Ability to present information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Additional Information
Statkraft manages critical infrastructure and services in several countries. The applicant must be eligible for security clearance and authorisation.
Statkraft's vision is to renew the way the world is powered. To navigate the complex journey ahead, we need every voice at the table. We therefore work actively to be a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome all applicants regardless of background, gender, age, sexual orientation, religious belief, ethnicity, nationality or disability.

jobs.title: Christmas Customer Assistant
jobs.desc:
Please note, this role is located in IRELAND
Ready to make someone's day this Christmas? Join Boots as a Seasonal Customer Assistant and be part of something special.
The festive season at Boots is one of the busiest and most exciting times of the year, and we're looking for enthusiastic people to help create brilliant experiences for our customers when it matters most.
About The Opportunity
As a Seasonal Customer Assistant, you'll be at the heart of the action, helping customers find the perfect gift, discover great offers and get what they need for the celebrations ahead.
You'll be the friendly face customers turn to for advice and support, creating feel-good moments that make a real difference and keep them coming back all year round.
This is an important role where you'll help deliver a great experience for our customers. It's also a fast-paced and active role where priorities can change quickly throughout the day.
You won't just be helping customers on the shop floor. You'll also support deliveries, replenish stock, and help keep the store looking its best.
Working in store is a real team effort, so you'll need to be flexible and ready to step into different areas to keep things running smoothly. You'll feel good knowing you're playing your part and enjoy a strong sense of teamwork and fun as everyone pulls together during our busiest season.
If you enjoy helping people, staying busy and being part of a supportive team, this could be the role for you.
This is a temporary role, with the potential for longer-term opportunities depending on local availability.
You Will
What you'll be doing
Welcome customers, understand their needs and help them find the right products, gifts, services and offers.
Create memorable customer experiences through friendly, personalised service.
Help customers complete purchases using tills and self-checkouts.
Replenish stock and keep shelves full
Support deliveries and help organise stock in the stockroom.
Keep the store and shopping areas look their best.
Work across different areas of the store and support your team wherever help is needed.
What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)
Available to work Bank Holidays including Black Friday week and weekend, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve, St Stephen's Day and New Year's Day.
Customer-focused — enjoys talking to people and helping customers have a great experience.
Team player — supports others and cares about team success.
Operations ready — comfortable balancing customer service with stock, fulfilment and shop floor tasks.
Proactive attitude — sees what needs doing and takes ownership.
Resilient — stays positive and focused during busy periods.
Energy and stamina — keeps energy high throughout long, active shifts.
Confident asking questions — asks for help when needed to get things right.
Comfortable with technology — learns new systems and confidently uses handheld devices, tills and self-checkouts.
It would be great if you also have
Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment.
Familiarity with Boots products and services.
Where your brilliance can take you
You’ll receive industry-recognised training and build valuable experience along the way. You may go on to explore more in Retail, Pharmacy, Beauty or Opticians, or ultimately progress into management. There are plenty of paths to follow for you to become brilliant with Boots —you can read some of our
colleagues stories here.
Rewards designed for you
Discretionary Christmas bonus
Generous employee discount (After 1 month’s service)
Access to our One Hub discount platform
There’s lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts – there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at
boots.jobs/ireland
Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.
A Bit About Us
At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time.
What’s next?
If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options.
If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best.
We hope to hear from you soon.
Be brilliant with Boots.

jobs.title: EMEA Tax Intern
jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
The Role:
The Regional Tax Intern assists Logitech tax team in EMEA with a variety of value added tax and corporate tax related projects such as tax return compliance, income tax accounting, tax audits, automation and use of AI, and other special projects as required. You will assist the EMEA tax team with transformation initiatives across systems, processes, and technology.
Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need to be successful at Logitech. In this role you will:
Assist in the preparation of corporate income tax returns of Logitech entities in the EMEA region.
Assist in the preparation of indirect tax returns including stamp duty, Value-added tax etc.
Assist in the preparation of tax support for tax audits and other special projects as required
Assist in corporate income tax related projects, legal entity restructuring, R&D tax incentives in various EMEA jurisdictions.
Assist in tax reporting based on international accounting standards (US GAAP).
Assist in automation and use of AI within tax processes.
Be involved in the project to migrate to a new ERP system.
Key Qualifications:
Relevant work experience with an accounting firm or a corporation preferred but not required.
Experience in statutory audit (financial statements) and/or income/indirect tax audits
Experience in tax reporting based on international accounting standards (US GAAP, IFRS) is advantageous.
General knowledge of income tax regulations and indirect tax rules.
Detail-oriented; ability to work independently and deliver quality results
Ability to participate in cross-functional, teamwork-oriented environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, WORD and PowerPoint
Experience with enterprise systems such as Oracle preferred but not required
High standard of personal integrity and work ethics
Familiarity with data and automation tools (e.g., OneStream, Alteryx) is advantageous.
Education:
BA/BS in Business/Accounting or equivalent; master’s degree in taxation preferred
Logitech is the sweet spot for people who are passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. As a company, we’re small and flexible enough for every person to take initiative and make things happen. But we’re big enough in our portfolio, and reach, for those actions to have a global impact. That’s a pretty sweet spot to be in and we’re always striving to keep it that way.
“

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future.
