jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager PDU (Internship)
jobs.desc:
Statkraft is a leading company in hydropower internationally and Europe's largest generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, and gas-fired power. Statkraft is a global company in energy market operations and has around 6,200 employees in 20 countries.
Because in the fight against climate change, we do not see renewable energy as part of the solution – we believe it must be the solution.
The business area European Wind and Solar (E) is responsible for development and ownership of wind and solar assets in Europe. The business area is also responsible for the project execution of large projects in Statkraft, the group procurement function and development of new business opportunities.
We are currently looking to recruit a Solar/Wind Project Manager Assistant (Intern Role) on a six month internship to strengthen the business area’s Project Delivery Unit. The team is responsible for the delivery of large-scale onshore wind and solar projects across Ireland
Job Description
As an Assistant to the Solar/Wind Project Manager; your main responsibilities will help to manage the pre-construction and construction of our solar & wind projects to include;
Assist in organising, leading and ensuring effective management and administration of the Project
Assist with coordinating the project team including external consultants, contractors, and service providers
Assist with ensuring continuous planning and follow up of cost, time and quality & reporting on projects status to senior management
Assist with the implementation of the Health, Safety and Environmental requirements and ensure HSE compliance including Project Health & safety monitoring, reporting & development, including managing planning & environmental permit conditions for the project
Assist with ensuring internal communication, co-operation, and co-ordination between the different staff members of the Project and with other parties with interface to the Project (Region, Country and Corporate)
Assist with ensuring efficient and regular project meetings and recording of minutes and agreed actions. This includes (but is not limited to) general internal project reporting, tracking of project spend & progress, tracking of project payments & variations and various project management documentation compilation and maintenance
Assist with managing the tendering processes for small and large works packages
Assist with managing the inputs from technical design team to finalize the design of the projects
Attend site as required to ensure successful delivery.
Assist with utilising Statkraft internal tools for payments, project tracking, safety, contract management, risk management etc
General contribution to the competence of the construction team for wind and solar renewable energy projects in Statkraft. Contribute to the business in other areas as required i.e. looking at how the Project Delivery Unit functions and map its processes and work streams.
Qualifications
Current Student of an Electrical / Engineering related college course
Team Player
Ability to work within a team and as an individual
Excellent communication skills in English
Strong Interest in Renewable Energy

jobs.title: Training Coordinator 12M FTC - Kinsale
jobs.desc:
Role:
Training Coordinator
Contract Type:
12 months | Temp Contract
Location:
Onsite, Cork - Kinsale
Working hours:
39 hours / week, Mon - Thu 8am-4.30pm, Fridays 8am - 3.40pm
Job Description
The Training Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and implementation of learning solutions across Kinsale, including administration of Kinsale curricula. The Training Coordinator partners with the business to ensure curricula adequately reflect job responsibilities and compliance-based activities. The Training Coordinator is responsible for training projects identified as fulfilling the learning capability and competency gaps in the assigned business area/function. Additionally, the Training Coordinator is responsible for activities required to maintain the overall state of compliance of the Training Compliance program.
The Training Coordinator monitors process, progress, results, and designs feedback loops into their work against measured goals. The Training Coordinator should anticipate and adjust for problems and roadblocks, interface with learning service suppliers, and integrate new business processes where necessary for success. The Training Coordinator provides support to ensure personnel are qualified and capable, which includes personnel fulfilling compliance requirements and continually increasing their contribution to the business.
Key Responsibilities
Training Coordinator Portfolio Management
Identify, analyze, and determine solutions regarding learning gaps.
Define requirements for personnel qualification in assigned business area/function; ensure implementation and ongoing maintenance.
Create, revise, and implement training and related documents, ensuring all documents are well written and executable.
Evaluate effectiveness of existing and planned learning interventions.
Evaluate human errors in business units and determine appropriate human error reduction interventions.
Collaborate/participate in Network/Functional initiatives.
Partner with the business in the creation and management of training materials.
Create initial project charters with defined scope documents and statements of work.
Participate on project teams; lead assigned projects.
Monitor and communicate deliverable status to key business partners.
Anticipate and resolve project/program issues, escalating as appropriate.
Oversee the portfolio of projects to ensure the on-time, on-budget creation of deliverables that meet quality standards, follow instructional design principles, are approved by appropriate personnel, and meet the needs of the business.
Drive quality standards through review of project documents, design, deliverables, final learning content and evaluation data.
Stay abreast of the breadth of learning solutions to guide business partners to the most effective learning methods, solutions and outcomes.
Benchmark within Learning and Development organizations in other sites, seeking sharing and replication opportunities.
Conduct usability testing as required.
Share business metrics and interpretations with management.
Client Management
Actively participate in area/function project and process teams.
Analyze/understand the assigned business area/function, including business goals, job titles and descriptions, key duties, and responsibilities.
Monitor client satisfaction of learning program implementation. Share results with management and make recommendations.
Surface improvement opportunities within Training Compliance.
Consult across the assigned business area/function to ensure training plans align with business plan, strategic direction, and compliance and ethics.
Effectively communicate updates for projects and assignments.
Curriculum Architecture and Assignment
Identify target audience for specific learning intervention.
Create and maintain duty-aligned curricula with business partners and support curricula owners in the business.
Ensure accuracy and appropriateness of target audience definitions for courses owned by assigned business area/function in the Learning Management System (LMS).
Troubleshoot curriculum architecture and assignment and resolve issues.
Implement centrally-developed process improvements in local area.
Basic Requirements:
Experience in technical writing
Demonstrated program/project management skills
Experience with learning & development and SOP business processes
Demonstrated ability to establish strong business relationships
Demonstrated ability in communication, conflict resolution, judgment and managing complex issues
Ability and willingness to challenge business partners regarding ways to use learning interventions to most effectively meet business requirements
Ability to work independently and in a team environment
Responsible for maintaining a safe work environment, working safely and accountable for supporting all Corporate and Site Goals
Additional Preferences:
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
Experience in business area/function as well as knowledge of companion tools used to execute broader business processes (such as CAPA tools/TrackWise, document repositories/Veeva QualityDocs)
Experience in supplier oversight
Ability to effectively partner outside functional area
Ability to navigate complex organizations
Strong organizational skills
Demonstrated ability to coach others
Education Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree or 2+ years of experience in a Learning & Development role
Other Information:
Travel may be required.
Applicant will work in various areas within a manufacturing site. Allergens are likely in the manufacturing environment. Mobility requirements and exposure to allergens should be considered when applying for this position.
Benefits :
23 days annual leave
EAP
10 days paid sick leave
Bike to work
Tax saver travel cards
Subsidised meals onsite

Establishes, administers and evolves standards and procedures for the Right to Information (RTI) component of the EU Pay Directive
Works closely with external partners and the Workplace Practices Team to ensure understanding of policy alignment/compliance, country requirements and nuances for initial country implementation and ongoing changes to legislation
Ensures alignment of outcomes with Total Rewards Philosophy and Global Pay Transparency program(s)
Leads RTI intake process for countries that have final act transpositions to prepare for system entry
Coordinates services for RTI through Service Now partnering closely with the HR Technologies Team to ensure requirements are documented, programmed and tested
Captures knowledge gained and leads communication of updates for RTI to ensure HRBPs and their aligned Managers are familiar with the process for their respective entity(s).
Leads the preparation of pay data through collection and analysis with local teams, scrubs and prepares data for use and ensures the accuracy of collected data
Serves as initial point of contact for escalations with technological errors associated with RTI requests

jobs.title: Technical Lead Manager
jobs.desc:
MongoDB is seeking an Engineering Manager to join the Atlas Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database-as-a-service offering and fastest growing product.
Atlas allows users to deploy fault-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. This includes developing software to interface with the three major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) in order to bring security, durability, availability, and performance to all deployments of MongoDB.
The Atlas Data Federation & Archiving team is an engineering team responsible for the Atlas capabilities that allow customers to move data from hot to cold storage and run federated queries over that data. The team builds Atlas Data Federation, a distributed query engine that lets users query data across Atlas Clusters and cloud object storage through a unified service. The team also builds Atlas Online Archive which allows customers to move data from Atlas Clusters into fully managed cloud object storage while preserving a seamless query experience across hot and cold datasets.
We are forming a new Atlas Data Federation & Archiving team in the Dublin area. The Engineering Manager who fills this position will be pivotal in growing that team.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Cork and would like a hybrid or in-office working model.
What you’ll do
Lead a team of motivated individual contributors who are eager to learn and grow
Contribute to the code, design, and architecture of the systems your team develops
Work with stakeholders throughout MongoDB to build our roadmap and product offerings
Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues and become part of our on-call rotation
Collaborate with team members to develop our codebase, best practices, and design principles
Foster an inclusive and respectful work environment according to MongoDB's Core Values
We’re looking for someone who
Has at least 6 years of professional software development experience
Has at least 3 years of people management experience
Has led engineering teams that have built and maintained large scale systems
Is skilled at writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Go, Java, C#, etc.)
Has experience with at least one major cloud provider technology (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud storage primitives (S3, GCS, Azure Blob)
Hands-on experience with petabyte-scale data infrastructure or storage systems
Is eager to solve tough problems
Has excellent communication skills
Is curious, collaborative, and motivated
Success Measures
In 1 month, you'll be familiar with the foundational parts of the system, the existing features, and projects within the Atlas Clusters team
In 3 months, you will be contributing to design and development of your team’s projects and working on your team’s growth
In 6 months, you and your team will have ramped enough to take on medium sized projects and you will be leading your team towards its product and engineering goals. You will be supporting our customers during escalations and have joined our on-call rotation
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Job Title:
Software Engineer II – Stratus HLS AI/LLM Systems
Location:
Cork, Ireland
Reports to:
Engineering Group Director, Stratus HLS
Job Overview
Cadence is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Stratus High Level Synthesis (HLS) engineering team in Cork. This role will contribute to building AI-powered tools that help engineers get more value from one of the EDA industry’s leading high-level synthesis platforms.
In this role, you will write production-quality C++ and Python code, design and test LLM-based agent systems, and develop IDE tooling. You will work alongside experienced software engineers in a technically deep, fast-moving environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to strengthen core software engineering skills while gaining cutting-edge experience in applied AI systems.
Job Responsibilities
Implement AI agent features that leverage LLMs for tasks such as code interpretation, code completion and code generation within the Stratus HLS environment.
Build and test agentic pipelines that connect Stratus tools and APIs to deliver context-aware guidance to users.
Apply prompt engineering techniques and contribute to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to improve the accuracy and relevance of AI responses.
Author and maintain Skills, including slash commands for AI coding agents such as Claude Code and openCode, encoding Stratus domain knowledge into reusable workflows.
Design Skills that orchestrate multi-step agentic flows, combining tool calls, context retrieval and structured prompts to automate complex Stratus operations reliably and repeatably.
Evaluate emerging LLM models and frameworks, including Claude, GPT-4 and open-source alternatives, and prototype their application to HLS workflows.
Instrument AI agent behaviour and contribute to quality metrics that track accuracy, latency and user experience.
Write, review and maintain clean, well-tested C++ code within the Stratus codebase, following established engineering standards and design patterns.
Read feature specifications and translate them into implementation plans, data structures and modular software designs.
Develop VS Code extension components in TypeScript/JavaScript that surface AI agent capabilities directly in the engineer’s IDE.
Write unit and integration tests, submit code through the Stratus regression system, and resolve failures to ensure every commit meets quality standards before release.
Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to strengthen both the codebase and personal development.
Participate in technical design reviews, contributing ideas and asking questions that sharpen the team’s understanding of problems.
Collaborate with senior engineers and domain experts to understand HLS workflows and apply that knowledge to well-engineered solutions.
Stay current with LLM and AI agent research, prototype new techniques and share findings with the engineering team.
Write clear engineering documentation, including design notes, API documentation and inline comments, so code decisions are understandable and maintainable over time.
Job Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field with 2+ years of relevant industry experience; or
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field with 1+ year of relevant industry experience.
Solid programming skills in C++ or another compiled, statically typed language, with an understanding of memory management, performance trade-offs and code organisation.
Proficiency in Python, including scripting for data processing, automation or ML workflows.
Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agent frameworks or machine learning tools through academic projects, internships or industry experience.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and fundamental software design principles such as modularity, separation of concerns and testability.
Ability to read specifications and break them into well-structured implementation tasks with clear interfaces and testable units.
Enthusiastic and motivated, with a genuine interest in writing good software and learning how complex systems work.
Collaborative team player who communicates clearly, accepts feedback constructively and asks for help when needed.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where both requirements and underlying technologies evolve frequently.
Additional Skills/Preferences
Experience writing Skills or slash commands for AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, openCode or other prompt-driven automation frameworks.
Familiarity with VS Code extension development or other IDE plugin frameworks, including Language Server Protocol and Debug Adapter Protocol.
Exposure to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, High Level Synthesis (HLS) or hardware design workflows.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases such as Chroma, Pinecone or Weaviate, or embedding pipelines.
Exposure to fine-tuning or instruction-tuning LLMs on domain-specific datasets.
Familiarity with Tcl scripting or scripted automation.
Basic understanding of cloud ML inference infrastructure, including AWS, GCP or Azure.
Open-source contributions to AI/ML or developer tooling projects.
Additional Information
The Stratus software engineering team is a collaborative group of engineers responsible for core HLS functionality, verification flows and increasingly AI-powered user experiences. The team places a strong emphasis on engineering craft, including readable code, thorough testing and well-considered design. New engineers benefit from close mentorship and regular pairing with senior team members.
Senior software engineers who provide mentorship and code review.
HLS algorithm and compiler engineers who provide domain expertise.
QA and release engineering teams who own the regression infrastructure.
A broader Cadence AI platform team sharing LLM infrastructure and tooling across product lines.

AI/ML frameworks: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, openCode
IDE tooling: VS Code Extension API, Language Server Protocol
Version control: SVN, Git, Perforce

Documentation: Confluence, internal wiki

jobs.title: Contract Process Analyst – Supply Chain & Operations Strategy
jobs.desc:
About the role
TechniStrat Consulting Limited is a boutique advisory firm specialising in Engineering, Automation and Supply Chain strategy for multinational life sciences and manufacturing clients across Europe.
We are seeking a contract Process Analyst to support client-facing engagements in supply chain strategy, distribution network design, logistics optimisation and operational transformation. You will turn large, complex operational datasets into clear insight, build the models and dashboards that underpin our recommendations, and work directly alongside client teams to map, measure and improve their processes.
Key responsibilities
Data and analytics
•     Collect, cleanse and integrate large operational datasets from client ERP, WMS, TMS and planning systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Manhattan, Blue Yonder).
•     Design and build scalable data models to support network, inventory, transport and cost analysis.
•     Develop interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards that track KPIs such as service level, cost-to-serve, inventory turns, OTIF and warehouse productivity.
•     Write and optimise SQL queries and DAX measures for performance on large data volumes.
Supply chain and network analysis
•     Build baseline models of current-state distribution networks, flows and costs.
•     Run scenario and sensitivity analysis to support distribution network design, site selection and 3PL / outsourcing decisions.
•     Analyse logistics performance to identify optimisation opportunities in transport, warehousing and inventory.
Process improvement and transformation
•     Map current- and future-state processes (SIPOC, swimlanes, value stream maps) through workshops and site visits.
•     Quantify gaps, root causes and improvement opportunities, and build supporting business cases.
•     Track benefits realisation and programme KPIs through implementation.
Client delivery
•     Translate analysis into clear, executive-ready insights, charts and presentations.
•     Work directly with client stakeholders from shop floor to senior leadership.
•     Maintain rigorous documentation of data sources, assumptions and model logic.
Required experience and skills
•     3–5 years in a process, data or business analyst role within supply chain, logistics, operations or consulting.
•     Strong hands-on experience with
Power BI
(data modelling, Power Query, DAX) and
Tableau
(calculated fields, LOD expressions, dashboard design).
•     Proven experience building and working with
large data models
— millions of rows, multiple source systems, star-schema design and performance tuning.
•     Advanced SQL; strong Excel skills.
•     Solid understanding of supply chain fundamentals: distribution networks, warehousing, transport, inventory and demand/supply planning.
•     Experience with process mapping and improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma or similar).
•     Ability to explain complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences, in writing and in person.
•     Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Data Analytics, Business or a related field.
•     Fluent English; Resident and eligible to work in Ireland / EU. Work Permit support will not be considered.
Desirable experience
•     Management consulting or client-facing project experience.
•     Life sciences, medical device or regulated (GMP/GxP) manufacturing and distribution environments.
•     Network design and optimisation tools (e.g. Coupa Supply Chain Guru / LLamasoft, AIMMS, anyLogistix).
•     Python or R for data preparation, analysis or modelling.
•     Cloud data platforms (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks) or Microsoft Fabric.
•     3PL selection, outsourcing or logistics tender support.
•     Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent; APICS / ASCM certification.
•     Additional European languages.
Personal attributes
•     Analytical and curious — you question the data and look for the story behind it.
•     Commercially minded — you connect analysis to cost, service and risk.
•     Self-directed and able to deliver with minimal supervision in a small, fast-moving team.
•     Confident with clients, comfortable leading workshops and site walk-throughs.
•     Organised and detail-oriented, with high standards for accuracy and documentation.
What we offer
•     Competitive day rate, depending on experience.
•     Exposure to high-impact supply chain programmes for multinational life sciences and manufacturing clients.
•     Close collaboration with senior practitioners with extensive industry leadership experience.
•     Flexible working arrangements.
How to apply
Send your CV and a short cover note, including your day rate expectation, availability and examples of Power BI / Tableau work you have delivered (screenshots or anonymised samples welcome).

Whats in it for you?

A variety of shifts
Part time and full time contracts available between 20 -  39 hours   a week
An hourly rate of pay for new drivers of €18.24 per hour with additional premium for Sunday working
Annual Bonus Scheme
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.*

24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. jobs.title: School meal worker (Hot Drop) - Ballygarvan GAA
jobs.desc:
A Little Bit About Us
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference - and fits into your day-to-day routine?
At The Lunch Bag, we deliver healthy, hot school meals to children across Ireland. We're the country’s leading school meal provider, and we’re on a mission to help children build healthy habits for life.
We’re changing children’s lives, one lunch at a time. Are you flexible, bubbly, and keen to bring a little extra joy to the school day? We’re looking for people who want to help us keep driving forward and doing something great. Bonus? You’re off when the schools are!
So, what’s the job?
We’re on the hunt for School Lunch Operatives – reliable, cheerful people who take pride in doing things right and bring a bit of warmth to every school day.
Think of yourself as the final link in the lunch chain. All meals are prepared in our headquarters in Nenagh, Tipperary, and then delivered to the Hot Drop Locations. It’s from there that you’ll take over. Your duties will consist of heating the meals in the oven, loading them into vans and driving them to the schools.
If you’re a detail addict and thought this was a little vague, here’s a list for you:
Load pre-packaged school meals into ovens.
Turn on oven and heat meals to specific temperature according to HACCP guidelines.
Unload ovens and load into vans.
Drive the lunches in a company vehicle to the local schools.
Ensure adequate stock levels.
Follow and maintain work and cleaning schedule.
Maintain temperature and cleaning records.
HACCP and Manual Handling Training will be provided.
What we’re looking for
Since you’ll be representing The Lunch Bag in schools, we’re looking for doers - people who are sound, good-natured, and genuinely care about doing a good job. Our values matter to us, and to keep improving the lives of children across the country, we need people who share that same goal.
We’re not asking for bodybuilders, but you do need to be able to lift 14kg boxes as part of the job. You may also need to climb some stairs – not every facility in Ireland has a lift
Working for children is really rewarding – their cute little faces can brighten your day... just don’t let them get hungry or they’ll turn into tiny monsters! So we’re looking for someone who can work quickly, stay calm under pressure, and still do things properly.
All you need is the ability to read English, have full clean Irish driving license, and heat each lunch with care.
We’re looking for cheerful people who like being out and about. Teleportation would make life easier, but until that arrives, we need drivers who are happy to take a roughly one-hour trip to deliver meals to local schools.
I still have questions actually…
No problem! We’re here to answer them.
When will I work?
This job is offered on a part-time basis, 5 hours a day, Monday through Friday! Typical hours of work are 08:30 to 13:30 with some flexibility required as start and finish times may be a little earlier or later.
Will I have to work all year long?
No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar. As a result, you will work with us approx 183 days of the year and will have the rest off to enjoy some well-deserved rest! Our staff sign on to Social Welfare as Educational Sector Workers during the summer months.
What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?
Well, for starters - a genuinely supportive team who’ve got your back.
The role’s flexible, ideal if you’re looking to ease back into work or just want something steady during school terms.
How much is it paid?
It’s THE question everybody is asking! The same way we take care of the children in the schools, we take care of our people. You will earn €14.65 per hour – 50c above minimum wage.

Are you an experienced Facilities Management professional with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering exceptional client service?
At Sodexo, we're looking for an experienced Account Manager to lead the delivery of integrated facilities management services across a multi-site portfolio in the West and South of Ireland. jobs.title: Additive Design Engineer (Staff)
jobs.desc:
Hybrid fixed term contract role based in Carrigtwohill, Cork running until 31st December 2027
Create imaginative, thorough, and practical technical solutions that are key to successful product development. Through patent protection and invention disclosure, protect the technologies that are core to the long-term success of the business.
You will work with a highly creative design team in and out of the company to invent and develop innovative successful new product concepts.  Create smart, innovative solutions to mechanical design challenges. Conducts research in problem areas of considerable scope and complexity.
Evaluate and optimize concepts for mechanical function and manufacturability. Develop product designs and create prototypes from customer concepts and/or specs to test and validate ideas.
Through statistical techniques and engineering tools, determine design approaches and parameters and create feasibility studies on new designs. Lead design review meetings, while building a technology network, both internal and external.
While understanding other functions capabilities, communicate with suppliers, advanced manufacturing engineering and product development to resolve issues and optimize design for manufacturability and efficiency. Will ensure designs are cost efficient, manufacturable and reliable.
You will lead and contribute significantly in efforts to identify, determine product requirements, generate production drawings for parts and assemblies and develop and manage full product design documentation.
This position is accountable for achieving product performance and quality objectives, project planning and effective execution, as well as communicating program status and escalating issues when appropriate.
Independently determines and develops approach to resolving end customers product related issues, through problem solving and troubleshooting product design, product training and relationship building.
All other duties as assigned.
Bachelor Engineering Degree (Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Design, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Materials Science) with a minimum of 4 years or more experience.
Excellent interpersonal skills - able to express ideas and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.  Open minded- able to recognize good ideas.
Innovative thinker - able to envision new and better ways to do things.
Experience in executing complex problem-solving techniques related to design/technical issues. Good instincts and sound judgment for mechanical and structural design.
Good understanding of statistical tools and validation/verification techniques.
Excellent analytical skills, ability to plan, organize, and implement multiple concurrent tasks.
Be able to analyze and correct complex product and/or process issues and make decisions using independent judgement.
Good working knowledge of CAM/CAE computer systems, engineering materials and design, coating technologies, plastic part design and advanced manufacturing technologies. Fluent in 3D CAD with good working knowledge of Finite Element Analysis tools.
Be able to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and have a good understanding of geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing.
You will have the ability to work with and assemble small objects and component parts. Ability to operate small hand tools and inspection equipment.
PC Literate (word processing, spreadsheets, data base) and strong knowledge of project Management tools is essential.
Willingness to travel internationally for live surgery visits and global partner collaboration, and work on international assignments.
Ireland Pay Ranges:
Ireland: €54,000 - €90,000 EUR Annual
At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

AECOM boasts an impressive and expansive Water Team operating across the globe; with approximately 700 water experts sitting in our UK and Ireland offices. We are constantly evolving to remain at the forefront of innovation, and we're on the lookout for talented, dedicated, and passionate individuals to join us.
Our Ireland Water Team are leading the way in delivering the most critical water infrastructure projects across the country through major national programmes for
Uisce Éireann
(Irish Water). AECOM is proud to have been supporting Uisce Eireann since the inception of its Resident Engineer programme seven years ago and are currently on the lookout for
Civil Resident Engineers
(Senior REs, REs & Assistant REs) to increase our existing team and support the delivery of Uisce Eireann’s Capital Investment Plan.
As a Resident Engineer you will work with Uisce Éireann framework providers to ensure each project is constructed to the specified quality standards. The work will involve major water and wastewater infrastructure and non-infrastructure projects, including new water and wastewater treatment plants and upgrades, pumping stations, water supply schemes, WwBG sewer rehab and reservoirs projects across all counties in the Republic of Ireland.
Reflecting Uisce Éireann and AECOM’s commitment to safety as a core value, you will be an ambassador for safety in this role. You will proactively improve the safety culture and implement all safety policies and standards on the construction projects.
Responsibilities include:
Lead the delivery of site-based infrastructure projects on behalf of Uisce Éireann, ensuring compliance with health & safety, quality, environmental, programme, and cost requirements.
Review and monitor Contractor documentation and performance, including HSQE submissions (RAMS, TMPs), CEMPs, quality plans, and adherence to contractual obligations.
Conduct regular site inspections, safety reviews, and quality audits, ensuring works are completed in accordance with specifications and approved proposals, and assist with incident investigations as required.
Supervise construction activities, maintain detailed project records, and support the coordination and monitoring of commissioning works to achieve timely project completion.
Administer commercial aspects of contracts, including assessment of interim and final accounts, variations, claims, and contractor performance against KPIs.
Develop and maintain effective communication with the Project Team, Employer’s Representative, Local Authorities, utility providers, landowners, and the public to ensure coordinated project delivery.

Impact:
We lead some of the largest infrastructure projects across the UK, Ireland, and globally. By joining us, you'll deliver designs that prioritise innovative and sustainable solutions, work on collaborative platforms and harness cutting-edge technology.
Growth:
We prioritise the professional growth of our team members from day one. We offer fast-track opportunities for development, making you a key member of a diverse, dynamic, and ever-expanding team.
Flexibility:
We believe careers should be built around people, not just projects. Whether you're looking to deepen a technical specialism, step into leadership, or explore new disciplines, we offer the flexibility, support, and career pathways to help you shape your own development.
If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, we want to hear from you. If you’re based in Ireland (or open to relocating here) with technical experience in the water sector, we would be delighted to hear from you.
Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
Degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering.
Experience in the site supervision of civil engineering construction works.
Experience working on infrastructure projects including water and wastewater treatment plants, pumping stations, pipelines and other large-scale civil works.
Strong knowledge of Health & Safety legislation, regulatory compliance, safety auditing and RAMS review.
Strong knowledge of construction contracts, including FIDIC, and experience in the assessment of Contractor claims and payment applications.
Experience in reviewing design submissions and participation in Project Workshops.
Familiarity with Quality Assurance Systems.
Able to travel to site.
Additional Information
We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.
Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. Experience developing new business within facilities management, outsourcing, property services or a similar B2B environment.

The commercial awareness to understand a client's requirements, scope a service and develop a considered proposal.
Strong relationship-building skills and credibility when dealing with senior stakeholders.
A self-starting approach, with the confidence to build something rather than relying on an established team or structure.

jobs.title: Spare Parts Technician
jobs.desc:
Spare Parts Technician
Location: Barnahely, Ringaskiddy, Co. Cork (On-site)
Duration: 12-month contract
Hours: Two-shift pattern (7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Monday–Wednesday, and 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Thursday–Friday with an alternating Thursday handover)
Imagine your next project taking the lead in managing critical store operations and inventory for a global leader in innovative medicine, supported by a competitive 20% shift allowance with no weekend work or travel required.
Operates out of the Facilities Store and Maintenance Office as part of a 5-person team. The job holder is responsible for managing the inventory of spare parts and ensuring the efficient operation of the storage area. This role involves receiving, storing, and issuing spare parts while maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with safety standards in accordance with J&J policies and standards.
roles and responsibilities
Storage and handling of Spare Parts and Consumables:
Ensure the Stores area is compliant with health & safety guidelines and ensure that any issues are highlighted in a timely manner. Ensure all Spare Parts are handled in accordance with health & safety guidelines. Ensure that the Stores area is kept clean and tidy at all times. Implement best practices with respect to the storage of spare parts and consumables.
Receiving and Inspection:
Accept deliveries from Main Warehouse daily. Check part against delivery paperwork, purchase order, and SAP to ensure the correct part has been delivered. If any parts are damaged, photographs are taken of the damaged parts and sent to purchasing. If certification is needed and has been received, it is stored with the spare part in its location. Complete the GR process in SAP, in accordance with TV-WI-39689.
Kit Preparation:
Ensure all kits are prepared and ready in a timely manner in accordance with the Maintenance PM and Calibration Schedule. Attend all meetings as appropriate with Maintenance Schedulers/Planners in relation to Work Order Planning & Execution and associated Spare Part availability. Support KPI targets for Kit availability.
Cycle Count:
Perform periodic cycle counts in accordance with TV-TEC-94802 & TV-WI-22478. Distribute cycle count reports to relevant stakeholders to keep them updated on inventory accuracy. Highlight significant findings, discrepancies, and recommended actions in these reports to facilitate informed decision making. Develop action plans to address any recurring discrepancies.
Documentation Management:
Ensure all documentation in relation to Spare Parts is stored in accordance with GMP. Maximize the use of electronic forms of documentation and storage in order to optimize the ease of document retrieval and navigation.
System Maintenance:
Ensure spare parts are set up in a timely manner for all new systems as per TV-WI-39358. Where a system is decommissioned, ensure the appropriate Spare Parts are written off the system. Ensure all changes to Spare Parts data are made in accordance with TV-WI-23221. Ensure all Spare Parts have the correct classification as per TV-TEC-94802.
Continuous Improvement:
Actively participate in continuous improvement projects which seek to further optimize the Spare Parts & Stores processes. Constantly seek to identify continuous improvement opportunities within the Spares & Stores processes.
Collaboration:
Actively participate in maintaining effective working relationships with Procurement Service Providers such as Eriks. Work closely with other departments to ensure timely availability of parts for maintenance and repair.
Other Duties:
Ensure that personal training requirements are completed in compliance with site and role requirements. Managing goods in and out, picking parts for maintenance, processing work orders, searching parts in the system, supporting breakdowns, accurate record-keeping, and managing spare part stock levels.
how to succeed
College leavers and warehouse-experienced candidates are considered with no strict prior experience required. Emphasizes a willingness to learn and develop, strong listening skills, and team alignment.
Good understanding of all stores procedures and operations.
Able to communicate openly, professionally, and honestly.
Experience in SAP and Spare Parts systems.
Working knowledge of GMP requirements.
Able to make logical decisions within their level of authority.
Showing initiative and continuously seeking improvement opportunities.
Ability to build relationships with teams across the organization.
Strong collaboration and influencing skills to partner effectively at all levels and across multiple groups.
Strong organization and prioritization skills.
Preferred related industry experience in healthcare, consumer goods, or electronics.
Preferred Six Sigma/LEAN certification, but not required.
Preferred communication skills.
Preferred procurement knowledge and vendor management skills.
Preferred business acumen.
Preferred working knowledge of GxP requirements and regulations.

jobs.title: Plumbing Apprenticeship - Cork
jobs.desc:
Join us, be part of more.
We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.
About your team:
We’re the pride of Ireland. Bord Gáis Energy have been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for almost 40 years. But now, we’re so much more than just gas and electric. Through our unique combination of household heroes and energy assets, we’re at the heart of the energy transition in Ireland, strengthening the country’s energy security and helping customers get ready for a net zero future.
About Your Role
Step into a career where your curiosity, determination, and appetite for hands‑on learning really count. As a
Plumbing Apprentice,
you’ll play a vital role in helping households enjoy reliable, efficient heating - while building a
future‑ready skillset
you can be genuinely proud of.
Whether you’re changing direction, starting fresh, or looking for a role with real purpose, this is your chance to grow. What matters most is your drive to learn, your problem‑solving spark, and your commitment to doing great work with care and confidence.
Throughout your apprenticeship, you’ll combine practical workplace experience with mandatory off-the-job training. You’ll develop the skills, knowledge and practical experience needed to thrive. You'll develop the skills and experience needed to install, maintain and repair plumbing and heating systems - from everyday domestic work through to emerging technologies such as heat pumps, solar hot water systems, smart heating controls and full heating system installations. You’ll learn how to keep systems running safely and at their best, bringing older systems back to life and making smart upgrades that boost performance. With the support of experienced engineers, you’ll build the confidence, capability, and know-how to make a real difference from day one.
This is a role where you'll make a real impact. You'll be out in the community, meeting customers, solving problems, and keeping homes safe and warm. No two days are the same - from fixing faults and maintaining plumbing and heating systems, to installing new technologies and helping customers run their systems more efficiently and reduce energy use. Every job is a chance to make a real difference.
If you’re looking for a career with purpose, progression, and hands‑on learning - and you want to feel supported as you grow - this could be your next step. Bring your ambition. Bring your curiosity.
We’ll help you turn it into a career that makes a difference.
Here's what we’re looking for:
You must be based in, or close to Cork
Minimum of five passes at Leaving Certificate level, including Mathematics
A valid full driving licence permitting the holder to drive in Ireland
Ability to travel between customer and work locations as required
Genuine interest in learning the plumbing trade and developing a long-term technical career
Comfortable carrying out practical work and using hand and power tools
Ability to work effectively as part of a team and learn from experienced engineers.
A willingness to take responsibility for your learning and successfully complete all workplace and off-the-job training and assessments.
Flexibility to attend mandatory off-the-job training at an assigned education or training location anywhere in Ireland. This may require travel and periods away from home
Here’s what's in it for you:
The opportunity to complete a nationally recognised Plumbing apprenticeship and become a qualified plumber.
Starting salary of €15,531 rising to €23,049 at 1 year, €34,573 at 2 years, & €41,487 after 3 years of your apprenticeship, with other add ons on top.
Structured workplace learning and support from experienced engineers throughout your apprenticeship.
Practical experience across plumbing, heating systems and newer low-carbon technologies.
Opportunities to build your knowledge of heat pumps, smart heating controls and other technologies that support Ireland’s transition towards net zero.
Access to a range of Bord Gáis Energy and Centrica employee benefits.
As you near completion, you may have the opportunity to apply for a permanent Heating Engineer or Service Engineer role. Successful candidates will receive further training to support progression towards becoming a qualified Gas Engineer, with opportunities to develop additional skills in heat pumps and other low-carbon technologies that support our net zero ambitions.
Please note:

About the Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Civil Engineer to join our growing Infrastructure team based in Cork.

Commercial and client-focused mindset.

Top Employers 2025 - Egis recognised across four continents for excellence in HR practices, having been awarded the prestigious Top Employer 2025 certification. Top Employers Institute is the global authority on recognising excellence in people practices.

jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
Located out of our Cork Office - 2 days per week min in the office.
The Role:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
The Digital Office is a service-centric organization where our Business Capability Teams are directly accountable for the end-to-end business capabilities they enable.
We are looking for a Business Capability Owner (BCO) for our Consumer Customer Experience (CX) capability. In this role, you will be the strategic partner to our Global CX Business Unit, enabling the technology that supports millions of customer interactions across the globe.
You are accountable for the strategic "what" and "why" of the capability. You will manage the roadmap for self-service, agent tools, and omnichannel support.
In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind the strategic evolution and continuous optimization of our entire Customer Experience (CX) technology ecosystem. This mandate extends beyond mere maintenance; it requires a visionary approach to ensure that our current technological landscape not only meets but also anticipates future organizational demands.
Your core responsibility will be to ensure maximum scalability, resilience, and adaptability across all CX platforms and tools. This involves a deep-dive assessment of existing architecture, identifying bottlenecks and areas for modernization, and developing a comprehensive, multi-year technology roadmap.
This roadmap must be meticulously aligned with the overarching strategic objectives and anticipated growth trajectories of the business, ensuring our CX technology is a competitive differentiator rather than a constraint.
Furthermore, you will champion initiatives to integrate disparate systems, harness the power of emerging technologies (such as AI and advanced analytics) to personalize and streamline customer interactions, and establish robust governance frameworks for data integrity and security within the CX domain.
Ultimately, your leadership will guarantee that our technology foundation is robust, forward-looking, and perfectly positioned to support the delivery of world-class customer experiences at scale.
Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.
In this role you will be responsible for:
CX Strategy & Platform Vision: Define the 3-5 year roadmap for our B2C Service technology.
Operational Alignment: Bridge the gap between technology and the contact center floor. You will translate high-level business goals (e.g., reducing Average Handle Time, increasing First Contact Resolution) into digital features that make agents' lives easier.
Backlog & Prioritization: Own and prioritize the capability roadmap, strategically balancing operational excellence with the integration of next-generation CX technologies. You will ensure our stack remains future-proof by evaluating and implementing AI-driven support, intelligent chatbots, and advanced self-service architectures.

Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary advisor to the Head of Global CX and Operations Directors. You are the "voice of the business" within the Digital Office.
Partnership: Collaborate relentlessly with your Technology Lead (TL) partner to ensure the strategic vision is translated into a scalable, secure technical solution.

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Strategic Leadership: Proven experience as a Product Manager, Service Delivery Manager, BCO, or Digital Transformation Lead specifically within the Customer Service / Support domain.
Operational DNA: You have strong business acumen regarding how a Support Center functions. Ideally, you have worked in a Customer Service Center in the past (e.g., as an Operations Manager, Supervisor, or Process Lead) before moving into Digital/Product. You understand the pressure agents face.
Ecosystem Modernization: Proven track record of leading large-scale digital transformations within a global CX environment. You have experience navigating the complexities of scaling, upgrading, or evolving enterprise-level tech stacks to meet high-growth business demands.
B2C Scale: Experience working with high-volume, B2C consumer models (Retail, Consumer Electronics, FMCG). You understand the complexity of global warranties, returns (RMA), and technical troubleshooting.
Preferred Qualifications:
Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Customer Service technology landscape (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Oracle Service, ServiceNow).
AI & Automation: Experience implementing chatbots, AI-assisted agent tools, or knowledge management systems.
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.
Experience with Consumer Electronics support specifically (hardware + software troubleshooting).

Overview
We are currently on the lookout for a Senior Procurement Buyer to join our PGCS Procurement team.We are the concentrate team in PepsiCo (PGCS) working across the Beverage, Nutrition and Snacks categories to deliver concentrate for many of PepsiCo’s mega brands including Gatorade, 7Up and Pepsi. We are at the heart of PepsiCo products, sourcing ingredients to manufacture more than 1,200 recipes for our brands. We are a global organization, situated in 15 locations across 8 countries offering careers in various functions from Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, R&D, HR, and IT. This is an exciting opportunity to join the global procurement team and play a key role in delivering procurement priorities across the Indirects category, with global spend of over $120m. The role will also play a key part in supplier partnership and relationship management, analyzing spend data, driving continuous improvement initiatives and digitalization across support center and the plants. This position offers exposure to a broad range of stakeholders and business priorities, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing commercial, operational, and strategic responsibilities.
Reporting to the Procurement Director, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, influencing decisions, solving problems, and delivering tangible business results through effective procurement practices.
This is a temporary basis opportunity for up to 18 months.

Procurement- Indirects Category Management
Execute procurement strategies across indirect spend portfolios
Manage indirect category portfolios, delivering commercial value, continuity of supply, and stakeholder requirements, collaborating cross functionally
Manage sourcing activities, including RFQs, RFPs, supplier selection, and contract implementation
Lead commercial negotiations, pricing reviews, and contract renewals
Deliver productivity, cost savings, and value creation initiatives. Consolidate global savings and pipeline for AOP
Monitor market trends and supplier capabilities to identify risks and opportunities
Provide spend analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and procurement insights to support decision-making
Monitor supplier cost movements and translate market intelligence into commercial recommendations
Influence budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders to support commercially sound decision
Champion procurement policies, GCS controls, compliance requirements, and best practices across the Cork locations and develop an Indirect community to share best practices and learnings with other PGCS indirect buyers across the globe
GPL for Ariba My Buy embedding the system and processes as well as developing strategy for next phase and optimisation of the solution
Qualifications
Essential Criteria:
Degree in Finance, Business Information Systems, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related discipline
5+ years in a multi-national environment
Knowledge of procurement processes and activities including sourcing, category management, spend base and tools, preferably in a fast-moving food & beverage or manufacturing environment. Ideally experienced in categories such as professional services, IT, MRO, HR/recruitment, energy and other operational services
Proven experience defining, implementing or influencing digital strategies in a complex business environment
Strong understanding and experience of governance, process optimisation, business transformation and change management
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into practical solutions
Highly effective interpersonal, communication and influencing skills across all organisational levels, including executive stakeholders; ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise executive-level communication
Ability to build credible relationships with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, IT senior stakeholders
High level of business acumen, with strong understanding of value drivers, cost drivers, risk, service and operational performance.
Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to identify opportunities, frame decisions and track value delivery
Organisationally savvy, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity, influence without direct authority and drive progress in a matrix organisation
Strong systems experience, preferably SAP, power-point, excel with a natural curiosity in AI

jobs.desc:
Role:

Location Base:
Lisgoold WwTP-Co.Cork
Salary:
Competitive salary
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
The main duties and responsibilities of the Civil Project Manager are outlined as follows:
Ensure HSE & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site.
Work closely and collaborate with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies.
Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation.
Lead the construction team in all aspects of the Civil Engineering and Building scope of works.
Liaise closely and support other engineering disciplines including mechanical, electrical and process engineering.
Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Represent the company as PSCS on live sites within your remit and co-ordinate all required documentation to be present on-site and up to date.
Conduct regular Health and Safety inspections on live sites as well as conducting and leading toolbox talks and white-board meetings.
Ensure best practice project management techniques are used such as Lean Construction and Last Planner.
Monitor project performance including risk and opportunities. Mitigate/reduce risk where possible and manage opportunities.
Report on the monthly performance of your project to the framework manager including performance against programme, budget and HSQE.
Lead the team in the procurement of supplies and sub-contracts on time and within budget.
Manage cashflow on projects and work with the Contracts Manager/ Commercial Manager to ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client.
Provide an active involvement in resource management and recruitment within your team as a hiring manager, oversight and guidance from time to time on tendering opportunities for new upcoming projects.
Respond to and address any client and stakeholder complaints in a timely manner. Obtain client satisfaction surveys and provide any feedback on how to improve our client satisfaction.
Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD).
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
The main knowledge, skills and experience required of the Civil Project Manager are outlined as follows:
Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in a similar role, preferably in the water and wastewater industry.
Extensive working knowledge of the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations 2013. Holder of a certificate in Managing Safely for Construction Managers preferable.
Experienced in civil engineering works such as bulk earthworks, cast in-situ concrete works, precast installations, building works, pipelaying and site finishes is preferable.
Minimum of a Level 8 Honours Degree in Civil Engineering.
Ability to engage with the customer as well as suppliers and sub-contractors in financial negotiations and final account agreements.
Good working knowledge of programme management software such as Microsoft Project. Ability to prepare baseline programmes and programme updates.
Ability to use own initiative, problem solve and adjust as issues arise during project delivery.
Excellent working knowledge of MS packages such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint and Project.
Full Driving License.
What we offer you:
The opportunity to join an ambitious and growing organisation.
Monday to Friday (39 hour working week).
22 days annual leave plus 10 bank holidays.
Competitive base salary.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Access to EAP – 24/7 365 days confidential employee counselling service, free to avail for employees and their families.

Glanua is an industry leader in providing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions to design, build, operate and maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure across Ireland and the UK. We are a trusted provider to the municipal and industrial sector where our clients include Ireland and the UK’s largest water utilities, Uisce Éireann (formally Irish Water), Thames Water, Yorkshire Water and Affinity Water.
We have a talented team of 600+ people across Ireland and the UK and are rapidly expanding our workforce across several disciplines to meet our ambitious growth plans.

jobs.title: Windows Audio Software Engineer
jobs.desc:
Windows Audio Software Engineer
12 Month Contract, Onsite, Cork
About the Company
My client is a world leading wireless technology innovator. They have an immediate requirement for a skilled e Engineer to join their team to work on designing and building next-generation
on-device Voice AI
capabilities.
About the Position
This role is a part of a team working on low-power “always-on” sensing through interactive speech experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, DSP, systems, ML, and product) and work with global stakeholders across regions and sites to deliver robust, production-ready solutions. .
Responsibilities
Own feature development end-to-end for Voice AI capabilities on Windows, including wake-on-voice, on-device ASR, translation, transcription, and TTS.
Gather and refine technical requirements with internal and external partners; translate product goals into clear engineering requirements, architecture, and milestones.
Co-design and implement Windows audio + driver stack solutions that leverage SoC CPU/DSP/NPU capabilities while meeting strict latency and power targets for Voice AI experiences.
Build or extend components across user-mode and kernel-mode boundaries (UMDF/KMDF), integrating with Windows audio frameworks and platform services as needed for Voice AI pipelines.
Drive low-power audio architecture for “always-on” use cases, including concurrency and power-mode transitions across multiple audio features.
Optimize and validate performance using Windows diagnostics and systematically debug complex multi-threaded and multi-processor issues across HW/SW boundaries.
Communicate development status, risks, and mitigations to technical leads and stakeholders.
Participate in roadmap planning and execution; contribute to process improvements that increase quality, scalability, and maintainability.
Experience
4-8 years of industry experience in software engineering, with a focus in one or more of the following areas: Windows system software, device drivers, multimedia/audio, platform software, or performance/power-sensitive products.
Proficiency in systems programming (C/C++ preferred) and ability to deliver production-quality code in complex codebases.
Strong Windows development skills using Visual Studio, source control (Git-based workflows), and disciplined debugging practices.
Solid understanding of Windows OS fundamentals relevant to system-level development: processes/threads, synchronization primitives, memory, I/O, and performance diagnostics.
Experience developing or integrating Windows drivers using KMDF and/or UMDF, including build, deployment, and debugging fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and performance/latency tuning.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively with distributed teams across regions/time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
Windows audio ecosystem experience (any of the following): audio drivers, audio endpoints, WASAPI, audio effects/APOs, audio policy, power-aware audio scenarios, or end-to-end audio pipeline integration.
Demonstrated experience using
AI-assisted development tools
to improve productivity across the software lifecycle (requirements/architecture, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation), with the ability to
iterate on prompts
and validate outputs against real code and requirements.
Familiarity with mainstream AI coding assistants (e.g.,
GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Copilot
) applied to practical engineering tasks such as code comprehension, change drafting, test scaffolding ideas, and documentation—while maintaining strong review and correctness discipline.
Ability to create and share
repeatable prompt patterns/templates
for common engineering workflows and continuously refine prompts to increase specificity and accuracy.
Experience with
low-power / always-on audio
and power-state transitions (e.g., Modern Standby constraints and wake/trigger flows).
Familiarity with on-device voice activation building blocks and staged verification concepts (e.g., multi-stage keyword/wake approaches).
Experience optimizing workloads across heterogeneous compute (
CPU + DSP + NPU
) and understanding tradeoffs across
latency vs. power vs. quality
.
Exposure to Voice AI pipelines: ASR/TTS, speech translation, transcription, streaming/buffering strategies, and real-time constraints.
Educational Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
Remuneration Package
Strong rate between 300-400 per day as well as high likelihood of extension.
Contact
Please contact Charlie Bigger on 01 5927867 or email c.bigger@brightwater.ie or simply click the apply button.

jobs.desc:
Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)
Salary:
€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets
How to apply
Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.
